summary: Iteration 9 (referral rewards, driver payout requests, monthly statements). Backend: new suite tests/test_referral_payout_statement.py passes 14/14 when run serially (-n 0). It covers /me/referral shape and stable code, the friend discount via a fresh OTP customer, own code 400, 'first booking' 400, unknown code 400, WELCOME10, the full friend booking→driver complete→referrer credit, notification and friends_completed flow, credit auto-applied and deducted on booking, credit restored on cancel, settings 0–5000 validation and ops 403, payout requests (min, max, duplicate, no UPI, ops 403, reject needs reason, approve creates a PAID driver_payouts entry, pending drops, notification, already-handled 400, 404), and statements (closing = opening + earnings − payouts = wallet pending; previous month closing = this month opening; future/bad month 400; customer 403; ?token= works). Frontend (390x844) passed: home and profile referral-card, book screen 'Referral from Ananya −₹100', driver Wallet payout request (Max, disabled under ₹100, submit, open state), statement chips and download in a new tab, ERP Finance payouts approve (reference prefilled, 'Confirm — money sent') and reject (reason required), ERP settings referral fields save and reject 6000. The code review found referral leaks (stacking, ops paths) — see issues. Regression: test_contacts_wallet_bonus + test_prajeta_api 30/32; the 2 failures are an older test-data flake ('Driver has a conflicting assignment': a fixed TOMORROW 11:00 slot clashes with leftover demo-driver jobs), not caused by iteration 9.

critical.issue: A new customer can apply the same referral code to several bookings. Reproduced with tests/edge_iter9_referral_double.py: 2 bookings were both stored with referral rewarded:false. is_first_booking() ignores PAYMENT_PENDING bookings, so each booking gets the friend discount. reward_referrer is idempotent per booking, not per friend, so once both are paid and completed the referrer is rewarded twice. Fix: allow only one referral booking per friend that is not cancelled, and reward each friend only once.

minor.issue: friends_joined counts bookings, not distinct friends: 1 friend with 2 bookings shows 2. Count distinct customer_id instead.
Completing a booking from ops never calls reward_referrer, so the referrer gets no reward (admin_routes.py set_status ~L384-414).
An ops cancellation does not give back the customer's referral credit_used; only the customer cancel route (server.py:379) does.

driver_payout = (subtotal − discount) × share, and discount includes the referral friend discount and referrer credit. Drivers therefore pay 70% of the platform's referral promo. Needs a business decision.
Non-numeric referral amounts return 'Badge bonus must be a number' (wrong field name in the message).
The web download puts the full long-lived access JWT in the URL (it leaks via browser history and logs). Use a short-lived download token.

integration_issues.issue: PayoutRequest returns null while loading or on API error, so the card silently disappears with no loading or error message (DriverWalletTools.tsx:19).
Months come from device local time but the server checks against IST. A device ahead of IST on the 1st of a month offers a 'future' month, which returns 400 (DriverWalletTools.tsx:71-79).

issues: The 'Referral: referrer earns ₹' label wraps to 2 lines, so its input sits lower than the 'friend saves' input next to it.
The referral Share/More buttons are 40px tall (below 44).
The home referral-card is not compact: it is the same ~230px card as on Profile, minus the stats.
After approve/reject the toast just says 'Saved'; something like 'Payout marked paid' / 'Request declined' would be clearer.

action_items: HIGH: Stop referral stacking. In compute_fare/create_booking, reject a referral code if the user already has a booking with a referral that is not cancelled. In reward_referrer, skip if a booking from the same friend was already rewarded.
Call reward_referrer in the admin set_status COMPLETED path; restore fare.credit_used on ops CANCELLED / NO_SHOW_CUSTOMER when amount_paid == 0.
Decide whether referral discount/credit should reduce driver_payout (currently it does).
Fix the settings validation message for referral fields.
PayoutRequest: show loading and error states instead of returning null.
Optional: build statement months in IST; use a short-lived statement download token; make Share buttons ≥44px; fix the settings label wrap.
